FearedInterrogator.description: Deals <style="Stat_Damage">+{[extraDmg]} Damage</style> against enemies that are <style="Debuff_Pinned">Suppressed</style>, <style="Debuff_Stunned">Stunned</style>, or that are adjacent to another friendly <style="Faction_DarkAngels">Dark Angel</style>. Scores <style="Stat">{[extraHits]}</style> additional <style="Stat_Hits">hits</style> if the enemy is also <style="Aliance_Chaos">Chaos</style>.
